title: Plan blocked — who starts the flow?
intent: Cannot grade the plan: it does not say what starts the flow or which code unit owns it. Ask; do not guess.

questions.ask: What starts this flow — a page in the web app, an API client, a message on the bus, a scheduled job, or something else?
questions.because: The plan has no entry actor, so there is no first hop to check against disk.

questions.ask: Which existing feature folder under apps/api/src/features/ owns this, or what is the new feature's name?
questions.because: Without the owner the inventory cannot tell existing work from new work.

questions.ask: After the request returns, is any remaining work done by the outbox relay, by a consumer on the bus, or nowhere?
questions.because: The plan says "in the background" without naming a mechanism that exists in this repo.
